architectural_fidelity.reason: Room is clearly recognizable: exposed brick wall maintained, white walls preserved, two windows in correct positions with white trim, dark wood flooring intact, ceiling height consistent, same camera angle and viewpoint.

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed—no bicycle, desk, boxes, chairs, or AC unit visible; floor is clean with no ghost outlines or remnants.

style_commitment.reason: Strong industrial conviction: exposed brick retained as focal feature, metal ductwork added along ceiling perimeter, leather furniture with industrial lines, metal-framed coffee table, gallery wall with black frames—unmistakably industrial, not generic neutral.

editorial_density.reason: Editorial-level staging achieved: gallery wall with 5+ framed prints, exposed industrial ductwork, layered textiles (throw on sofa, area rug visible), multiple furniture pieces (leather chair, sofa, coffee table, console), plant in corner, window vignette with decor—meets Architectural Digest density standard.

photorealism.reason: Realistic lighting with natural window light casting appropriate shadows, brick texture authentic, wood floor grain and reflections accurate, furniture materials (leather, metal, wicker) rendered convincingly with proper weight and scale—no CGI plasticity.

designer_preference_reason: Cova delivers a cohesive industrial living room that honors the original architecture while Collov's bedroom conversions ignore the brief entirely.
what_cova_does_better: Preserves and celebrates the existing exposed brick as an industrial asset rather than painting over architectural character
Adds contextually appropriate industrial elements (exposed ductwork) that enhance authenticity
Delivers the actual requested room type (living room) with appropriate furniture layout
Maintains the raw, authentic character of the space while making it market-ready
what_collov_does_better: Slightly higher resolution and sharpness in rendering quality
More sophisticated layering of textiles and bedding details
Cleaner, more polished commercial photography aesthetic
